components.name: Android current-polyday widget
components.description: Todoist-reference native widget: flat white panel, clipped 24dp corners, no border or outer padding; warm 48dp header with a medium-weight 16sp accent title, Lucide RefreshCw and Lucide Plus on a circular tomato action surface (24-unit geometry, two-unit strokes and rounded caps/joins; native vectors from lucide-react-native 0.577.0 with bundled ISC license), refresh and add in separate 48dp targets. Full-width rows have a 54dp minimum height, 1dp separators, separate 48dp completion targets and two-line 14sp titles. Lucide Circle completion vectors use a 24dp size/24-unit viewport and 20-unit circles: native P1–P3 colors with faint fills and two-unit strokes; transparent widget P4 with a 1.3-unit outline. Right-aligned 11sp overdue/deadline metadata hides when empty. The 10sp footer pairs localized date/range and projection freshness; separate 11sp tomato status hides when empty and never replaces freshness. Title/empty state open the current polyday; add opens polydays://current?addTask=1 with current-polyday scheduling. Task text opens the inline editor in its list; completion persists locally and schedules sync, including offline. Refresh updates the local widget and schedules sync. Prepared projections retain represented-polyday, order and origin authority. Static synthetic HTML preview translates dp/sp to CSS px for inspection; native text scaling, focus and launcher footprint remain platform-owned. Preview shows P3 and P4, with empty metadata/status hidden.

components.name: Browser device authorization
components.description: Browser approval for Mac sign-in, using the shared Field, primary/secondary Button and ErrorMessage. The growing ScrollView centres a fluid panel (maximum 410 source pixels), with 24 source-unit outer padding, spacing.8 panel padding and spacing.6 gaps; short viewports scroll to both actions. Busy requests lock the field and actions; empty codes disable both actions. Invalid/expired codes ask users to restart Mac sign-in. A persistent, initially empty polite live Text receives approval/denial and the next step in ink; the form then disappears. Static preview uses synthetic data. The macOS host bundles the shared RN Web client and reuses the existing components and tokens; macOS widgets remain deferred.

components.name: OAuth and connections
components.description: Server-rendered login, consent and connection management share a flat white card (maximum 440px, 12px corners, 32px padding) on warm white, with a system font and tomato vector mark/actions. At viewport widths up to 480px, outer/card padding is 16px/24px. Full-width actions have a 44px minimum height and 6px corners; hover preserves their colors, with no authored animation or press treatment. Pending requests disable all buttons at 65% opacity with a wait cursor and change the initiating label to Подождите…. Failures restore the label and enable retry; a persistent polite alert shows Russian transport/parser recovery in pale red. Connection management uses a wrapping monospace MCP address and flat, top-bordered connection sections with muted scope summaries and secondary revoke actions. Static preview shows consent with synthetic data.

narrative.northStar: Familiar Todoist task lists organised around personal wake intervals.
narrative.overview:
Polydays uses the user's pinned Todoist canon: compact task rows, warm white content, pale warm navigation, restrained tomato accents and system sans typography. Familiar navigation and separate completion circles keep repeated capture and completion direct.

The shared React Native and React Native for Web interface stays light, including in system dark mode. The macOS host bundles the shared RN Web client; macOS widgets remain deferred. Android widgets retain their separate native palette and dimensions. The direction contract is [Task lists](apps/client/.impeccable/surfaces/apps-client-src-app.md), with domain language in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md) and product authority in [docs/product.md](docs/product.md). Icons are Lucide vectors; no generated raster assets ship.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, priority-first task lists with separate completion and details targets.
Flat white surfaces, warm navigation and fine separators.
Tomato selection and action cues; P1–P4 remain distinct.
Collapsible desktop navigation and compact mobile destinations.
Contextual inline desktop and modal mobile capture with progressive task controls.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Use tomato for action, selection and overdue cues; keep ordinary content surfaces white or warm neutral.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep task titles visually primary and metadata subordinate; preserve the short mobile captions as text scales.

rules.name: The Flat Task Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep task rows and ordinary panels free of decorative lift; reserve the existing shadows for overlays, floating add actions and notices.

dos: Do preserve the pinned Todoist density, familiar destinations and separate completion circles.
Do keep P1–P4 visually distinct and task order priority-first.
Do let interval and metadata rows wrap, and retain compact mobile captions.
Do retain original polyday context for overdue work; keep widget freshness in the quiet footer and actionable status separately visible.
Do keep the interface light when the system switches to dark mode.
donts: Don't replace flat task lists with decorative cards, gradients or additional display typography.
Don't infer Android physical sizes from web CSS or shared utility names.
Don't invent motion curves or tonal ramps; use the documented source hover states.
Don't expose a direct polyday move for an existing deadline before explicit deadline removal.
Don't let shell or row shortcuts capture typing or inactive contexts; reserve Ctrl/Meta K for search.
Don't apply shared-client colors or CSS dimensions to native widget resources.
